patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; LucroVox is narrower/specialist.

General-purpose vs specialist. Choose LucroVox only if your buying job matches “Business software platform — affiliate partner in marketing.” rather than Adobe Marketo Engage's shape. Choose Adobe Marketo Engage only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM se” rather than LucroVox's shape. Workflow advantage: LucroVox leans shared coverage; Adobe Marketo Engage leans lead-generation, lead-nurturing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; LucroVox is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: LucroVox is Business software platform — affiliate partner in marketing.; Adobe Marketo Engage is Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM secondary..
- Company-size focus: LucroVox (small-business, mid-market) vs Adobe Marketo Engage (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: LucroVox-leaning — vs Adobe Marketo Engage-leaning lead-generation, lead-nurturing, analytics.
- Researched limits: LucroVox — SMB bundle — not enterprise marketing cloud; Adobe Marketo Engage — Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency.

Limitations — LucroVox: SMB bundle — not enterprise marketing cloud; Adobe Marketo Engage: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Implementation/ops overhead is enterprise-grade.
